steps: Scan running processes using psutil for LeagueClientUx.exe or LeagueClient.exe
Read command-line arguments to extract app-port and remoting-auth-token
If access denied, locate process directory and read physical lockfile
Construct basic auth header using credentials and target 127.0.0.1 with port
Start background WebSocket for OnJsonApiEvent updates
Retrieve encrypted password_enc from accounts.json
Decrypt password using win32crypt.CryptUnprotectData
Locate local Riot Client port and token
Send PUT request to /rso-authenticator/v1/authentication with credentials
If response is multifactor, prompt the user; if success, launch League of Legends
Map current Queue ID to mode baseline dataset
Spawn thread using ThreadPoolExecutor to scrape Lolalytics page in background
If bs4 available, parse champion names and win rate cells, updating memory cache
Return scraped win rate if cached and timestamp < 30 minutes; otherwise return mode baseline
Read RiotClientInstalls.json to resolve installation directories for Riot Client and League of Legends
Perform a single process list iteration to find PIDs and cmdline arguments for both clients
If cmdline arguments are not accessible, read the lockfile directly from the resolved install directories
Cache the results using a 2-second TTL to prevent performance overhead on multiple queries
Add default flag 'is_default' to accounts.json profile schema
Create set_default_account(idx) and get_default_account_index() API in AccountManager
Integrate default selection checkbox in accounts UI add/edit form
Check connection state at application startup; if disconnected and a default account exists, trigger client launch and login macros automatically after a 2-second delay
Define a PySide6 QWidget with a custom Property 'sidebar_width' using a setter calling setFixedWidth
Instantiate a QPropertyAnimation targeting this property, set duration and easing curves
On toggle click, stop the animation, configure start and end width values (e.g. 56px and 160px), and trigger start()
Hide or show labels and category headers immediately or upon animation state change to ensure clean visual flow
